newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-CBA's ASB posts 22 pct higher profit.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-CBA's ASB posts 22 pct higher profit.

text.p: Commonwealth Bank of Australia (CBA) said on Tuesday that its New Zealand unit, the ASB Bank, posted a 22 percent higher net profit of NZ$40 million in the six months to December 31.
"In New Zealand, new business growth in all areas of ASB Bank's operations produced a good result," CBA said.
Earlier CBA announced a 11 percent rise in first half profit to A$602 million, well above the A$535 million to A$560 million analysts had forecast.
CBA said better than expected business volumes and good cost control led to the better than expected result. It said this was likely to lead to a better than expected full year result.
